steps.content: [Eastside] - Past [Flashbulb Effect] + Flashback Filter
<color=#FFC9F3><i>To love the spotlight, to crave love and attention... Is that really so strange?</color>
A white room. A sharp, acrid smell. The steady beeping of machines. This place is...

steps.speaker: Blurry Face
steps.content: ■■, what do you know about what your parents did? Were you involved?

steps.speaker: Blurry Face
steps.content: Did you really lose your memory? Or is it just a convenient excuse to dodge the public's scrutiny?

steps.speaker: Blurry Face
steps.content: The case is still under investigation. Do not release any images of the individuals involved!

steps.speaker: Blurry Face
steps.content: This is a hospital. The patient hasn't recovered yet. You need to leave!
Her heart won't stop pounding. Her temperature is climbing. Those faces and voices from her memories are nothing but a blur now. What remains is noise and chaos.

It all dissolves into strings of scrambled code, flooding her vision. What follows is a searing headache, causing her to clutch her head and scream. Through the tears, something stirs inside her—a strange, roiling power clawing its way to the surface.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: I'm sorry... I really can't remember...
Streaks of tears mark her face as she manages a smile, confused and apologetic. Somehow, the strange power within her reaches out and smooths away those scrambled codes filling the space.

steps.speaker: Blurry Face
steps.content: If she can't remember, then that's that... She's just a child, after all.

steps.speaker: Blurry Face
steps.content: Exactly. Her parents might be criminals, but that doesn't mean she's one too. Stop putting a child through even more trauma!

She doesn't understand what is happening. All she knows is that whenever she smiles, the people around her suddenly become warm and kind. Slowly, she finds herself drawn to that feeling of being pursued by the spotlight, of being embraced by a crowd.

She can't tell whether those words mean well or harm. All she knows is that when people talk about her, look at her, it fills the emptiness in her heart. It soothes the restless power stirring within her.
A smile. That was the gift she received in the wake of that upheaval.
[Scene Change] - Hypnotherapy Room
<color=#FFC9F3><i>How long has it been since she last saw darkness like this?</color>
She opens her eyes to a calming blue. The rich scent of incense drifts through the air, easing her nerves.
Within that soft light, a counselor in a white professional suit sits at her side.

steps.speaker: Counselor
steps.content: Phanuel, can you hear me?
Phanuel blinks slowly, adjusting to the haziness.

steps.speaker: Counselor
steps.content: Good. Relax a little. Take a look at the lights in the room, and feel the chair against your back. You're at the Bureau now. You're safe.
Right. This is the Bureau.

It has been a few days since the press conference. In that time, the Chief has not pressured her further, and has instead done exactly as she hoped, giving her directives and keeping her schedule filled.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I'm sorry. I still can't remember anything.
She's lying.

steps.speaker: Counselor
steps.content: There's no need to apologize. I'm here to check in on how you're feeling, not whether you've recovered some of your memories, after all. Now then, any heart palpitations, ringing in your ears, nausea, or noticeable physical pain?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I'm a little tired, I guess...

steps.speaker: Counselor
steps.content: Fatigue is worth noting too. Your breathing quickened a few times just now. You don't have to tell me what it was about, but can you tell me what it felt closer to: is it fear, resistance, or sadness?
Phanuel blinks, as if trying to recall the dream she just had.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Hmm... if I had to say, probably nothing at all.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: At least Phanuel got a good night's sleep out of it though!
The counselor chuckles, and logs the day's notes on the terminal.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Maybe... It's okay if I never get my memories back, and it's time to start a new chapter? "The Angel Idol Phanuel's Rebirth: My Days as a Model Student at the Bureau"?

steps.speaker: Counselor
steps.content: That's all for today. If you experience any nightmares, auditory hallucinations, or strong reactions to certain words going forward, please inform me or any other medical staff right away.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Got it! Hehe, Phanuel has finished this morning's schedule already. As expected of me! Now I need to find Chief and ask him to add something new to my itinerary.
steps.female_content: Got it! Hehe, Phanuel's finished this morning's schedule already. As expected of me! Now I need to find Chief and ask her to add something new to my itinerary.

steps.content: The girl seals away her past in the black box of memory, as fate pushes her forward, shedding one <color=#fb9259>unimportant</color> thing after another.
What she doesn't know is that the flowers, the applause, and the adoration that so easily fall into her arms were never free. Fate has simply hidden the price tag from her, for now.
And so she took the easiest path. One with no responsibilities to shoulder, no mistakes to own, nor the need to decide where she was headed.

<color=#FFC9F3><i>She simply leaves everything to fate. Even as that path slowly tilted off course, leading her further down the point of no return, she still believed she had finally found the life she always wanted.</color>
[Eastside] Past + Flashback Filter
<color=#FFC9F3><i>This is all it takes to have everything? Then... I don't see why not.</color>
Her smile was what brought her into the public eye. It was the beginning of her next life. A woman arrived with a business card, and became her foster mother.

She found tutors for her, arranged every last detail of her daily life—skincare, posture training, food and lodging, vocal and dance lessons... She didn't need to think about anything. All she had to do was work through each item on her daily schedule, and countless people would love her.

Her life has become far more comfortable than anything she had ever known, so much so that she genuinely forgot about the parents she had never been close to, and the dull past that came with them. Or, perhaps, young as she was, she had already read the danger in Eliza's eyes.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: From today, your name is <color=#FFC9F3>Phanuel</color>. Whether or not you remember your past, I don't care. If anything, it's better that you don't. You're going to become Eastside's brightest star, the idol of thousands.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Your future is bright. You will become a superstar. All you have to do is be a good girl and do as you're told, and that smile of yours will get you everything... Am I clear?
What was Eliza to her? A mother? A superior? A caretaker? Perhaps all of the above. After all, she tended to her every need, gave her a life free of worry, and raised her to the clouds.
Her past was wiped clean by a mysterious power. An idol cannot have a stain on their name, much less if that stain is their parents.

She did forget everything about the past, if only briefly. But as the power within her settled, those scattered memories came back to her, piece by piece. By then, however, she could no longer speak of them. Even if she remembered, she must forget again.
<color=#FFC9F3><i>After all... a lie can only be held together by countless more.</color>
[Scene Change] Bureau Cafeteria / Recreation Area?

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Oh wow, Phanuel! It's so rare to see you here. Have you finally figured out how to eat fish?!
Phanuel has been locked in a staring contest with the fish on her tray. Upon hearing Wynn's voice, she looks up with an awkward smile.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Yup... Chief said the Bureau isn't a daycare, so I need to learn to take care of myself. Look, my task for today is to "eat a whole fish on my own without choking on a bone."
She holds up the schedule and shows it to Wynn with a grin. That said, both Phanuel's expression and the untouched fish on her tray say plenty about how out of her depth she truly is.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Ugh, I swear, Chief really needs to learn that some things must be done one step at a time! Next time, I'll ask the kitchen to swap it out for a fish with fewer bones!
Wynn pulls a chair over to sit beside Phanuel and rolls up her sleeves.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: I'm great at this sort of thing, so let me teach you the ropes! If anything, nothing makes me happier than being able to help you, Phanuel!

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Then... I'll leave it to you!

Unfortunately, somewhere down the line, Wynn became practically enthralled from being up close with Phanuel. And so, the "teacher" became a caretaker, picking out every bone for Phanuel before she could even touch it.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Phanuel, your smile is so beautiful...

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Thank you, Wynn. Here, this is for you.
She holds out a CD with "To Wynn" written on it, along with an adorable little doodle of an angel throwing a peace sign. Wynn clutches it like it's the greatest treasure in the world and skips away.

Reading people, managing her image, deploying small and harmless calculations to keep her fans' affection intact... These have all become instinct for Phanuel. Because to her, seeing everyone's smiles is the only way for her to know for sure that she did well.

She once craved the worship of adoring crowds. But when the flowers, the applause, and the love finally came pouring in, her heart remained hollow. Why is it that the tiniest glimmer of her light can make these people overjoyed?

As Wynn's footsteps fade, Phanuel drops her angelic smile and tries to make an ordinary one instead, something plain but real. She tugs at the corners of her mouth a few times, but her face refuses to relax, so the resulting expression is strange, to say the least. She gives up.

She sighs and looks down at her tray. The carefully deboned fish sits there, so neatly arranged it almost feels like an act of flattery. She pokes at it idly, picks up a piece, and brings it to her lips.
A stray bone pokes out from the flesh. Phanuel wrinkles her nose.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Oh no, what do I do? Wynn worked so hard on this...
The old Phanuel would have tipped the whole tray into the trash without a second thought. Now, however... she stares at the offending bone.
[Scene Change] Chief's Office + Flashback Filter

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: These gifts were found when we searched your home. I assumed they would be things that mattered to you, but their condition seems... less than ideal.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You shouldn't treat other people's feelings like something you can just throw away.
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Well... if Chief says so... food made with love should be eaten with gratitude.
The girl mutters to herself. It sounds both like a complaint and an excuse. She reaches out and carefully pinches away the bone, something she once would never have touched.
<color=#FFC9F3><i>The steamed fish tastes pretty ordinary. But it's not bad, either.</color>
[Scene Change] Mansion + Flashback Filter

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: All the files have been transferred, and everything that needed to be destroyed has been taken care of. Even if the plan falls through, they won't find anything. I was the only one who was ever involved—the temp drivers and assistants don't know a thing.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Phanuel? Don't worry. I've been watching and testing her throughout her training. She's exactly what I was looking for. A hollow doll, and nothing more. She has no capacity to jeopardize our plans.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: I've coached her on what to say to the media. She'll do as told.
To Eliza, what was she, really? A tool? An adopted daughter? Or... just a pawn?

Eliza might've believed otherwise, but Phanuel knew everything. She knew there was a mysterious mastermind behind Eliza, and she knew her light sticks truly held <color=#fb9259>magic</color>. But more than anything, she knew that an ignorant Phanuel was exactly what Eliza wanted.
[Scene Change] Interrogation Room + Flashback Filter

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You really don't remember her? She was your adoptive mother and your manager. Her name was Eliza.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: ...Even so, I don't remember her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Perhaps it's for the best. When we found her, she was already dead. You may have lost your memories, but I felt you deserved to know. My condolences.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Thank you, Chief.
She wears the same expression she had when she first saw the photos of her birth parents. Calm, with just a trace of discomfort, as though looking at a stranger.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I'm sorry. I really should be feeling sad right now, shouldn't I? But I just... don't remember her.
She hands the photo back to Chief. Her acting is flawless.
When she heard the news of Eliza's death, Phanuel's mind did go blank for just a moment. But instinct told her to keep smiling.
She still hears Eliza's voice sometimes, urging her on just like before. It is only when no one comes to wake her, to peel her shrimp, that she remembers she is alone now.
Eliza shaped Phanuel into a sun, while she herself walked through the darkness where Phanuel could never see. Even her death was just out of sight.

Phanuel has never forgotten the awe on Eliza's face the first time she saw her smile. Since then, she has seen countless eyes look at her that same way, and it is in those eyes that she found meaning in her own existence.
Until...
[Scene Change] Press Conference Venue + Flashback Filter

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You never actually lost your memory.
[Thump thump, thump thump, thump thump, add heartbeat sound effect, a girl falling in love (bur]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And not just this time...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The last time you <color=#fb9259>reset your life</color>, too.
[Thump thump, thump thump, thump thump, add heartbeat sound effect, a girl falling in love (bur]
[Black Screen Transition] Bureau Office
The office door is left ajar. Inside, Nightingale is briefing you on the follow-up to the attack at the press conference.

The investigation is drawing to a close. As you suspected, Phanuel truly knows nothing of the inner workings, and poses no threat to those pulling the strings. If she did, they would have silenced her from the start, just as they did with her manager, Eliza.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, how's the wound on your hand? Have you had it redressed yet?
You meet Nightingale's concerned gaze, and lift your arm to show her you're fine. The bandage on it, tied into a bow by Phanuel after she'd insisted on wrapping it herself, speaks for itself.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The attacker from the press conference has been taken into custody. According to his statement, he has no ties to Mirrormoon Entertainment. He infiltrated the venue purely out of a desire for revenge. Even the weapon was brought in by another fan, as per a request he posted online.
Your hand stops over the report.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Folk wisdom, huh? That's impressive in its own right.

The suspect's fifteen-year-old son had been reduced to a vegetative state by the Hollow Syndrome. The suspect himself had taken part in protests, all to no avail, and fell under the influence of Mania while seeking some sort of resolution. Fortunately, the corruption had not run deep. You sigh as you read through the long list of grievances in the report.

This father had no way of knowing how much filth and corruption lay behind the case. All he could see was that Phanuel had destroyed his family, along with his life. As such, that's where he pointed his blade.
You had hoped the livestream would draw out the true mastermind behind the incident. Instead, all it brought was the revenge of yet another victim.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, Phanuel has been far too cooperative. From the interrogation room to the press conference, and her strange behavior after the attack... I cannot say this bodes well.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know what you're worried about.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She's been acting all along. From the moment she entered the Bureau, the amnesia was an act, the innocence was an act, and even her recent eagerness to please me is an act.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Then why not expose her?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And then what? She'll break down in tears, see the error of her ways, and turn over a new leaf? I'm sorry to say, she was never going to become what we wish for her to be.
[Flash: Several CGs of Phanuel's past]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She never had any ambitions. All it took was a pretty face and a smile that could poison any heart, and the industry came calling. She became a puppet, a piece of someone else's plan. Like any idol churned out by the machine, she sold an emotional bond, and her fans paid with their time and money.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Her fans put her on a pedestal and crowned her with an angel's halo, and she genuinely loved every second of it. She tried to use the livestream and the press conference to win sympathy, hoping to reclaim that life. And she might've, had I not seen through it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The company is gone. So is her path as an idol. She knows there's no going back. The Bureau has become her only refuge, and so I gave her a new goal—to become a model Sinner.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's no different from what she's always done. She plays the part well. She's a smart girl, and she adapts. She knows this is what's best for her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She's undoubtedly still putting on an act, sure, but if she can keep it up for a lifetime, then is it really a problem still? A lie told often enough becomes the truth, as they say.

You hand the case report back to Nightingale. Tucked inside the first page is Phanuel's mugshot. Even here, her smile is picture-perfect and sweet enough to pass as the cover of a Bureau promotional video.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: At least... she won't be hurting anyone else.
You pause, glancing at Phanuel's schedule on the terminal, still mostly empty, and let out a sigh.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Gotta hand it to all the idol managers out there, though. This really is no easy job. I never knew scheduling a person's day could be this draining.
Creak. The office door cracks open.
What comes through first is a fuzzy little head, golden twin-tails, a tiny halo and all, followed by a pair of shiny, bright eyes.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Chief...

Phanuel slips into the office like she owns the place, her footsteps light, twin tails bouncing with unabashed pride, springy as rabbit ears. She plants herself in front of the desk and puffs her chest out with a bright smile.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Reporting in! Phanuel has completed today's schedule. Counseling, skills training, independent living class—everything is checked off.
She fishes out a neatly folded schedule from her pocket and presents it to you with both hands.
The whole good-girl-seeking-praise routine is far too practiced, and far too shameless. Worse still, it means you, her manager now, will have to hurry up and arrange the next phase of her schedule.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Alright, but did you need something from me?

choices.text: Alright, but did you need something from me?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: That's it? You're not going to compliment me, Chief?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Don't you think we're missing something here, Chief? Like... Maybe a compliment or two?
She blinks, wearing an innocent smile, her voice trailing off in a soft lilt.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: For what?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: For being a good girl, for working so hard, for being a true model Sinner, anything. Phanuel isn't picky.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Everything you did today was on a schedule you asked me to put together for you though. Down to the hour.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I know!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So it's not like I really made you do them.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I know!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: What exactly are you trying to do?

choices.text: What exactly are you trying to do?

steps.content: She rests her chin on the back of her hand, eyes fixed on you.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: You know what Phanuel wants though. Right, Chief?
She clears her throat, deliberately dropping her voice to mimic your tone.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: "What you want isn't orders, but a life where everything comes easily. Isn't that right?"

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: That line was so cool! It left such an impression on Phanuel, and it hits way harder than any song or lyric I've ever written!

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I should've recorded it with a talking plushie, so I could have Chief's greatest quotes on loop by my bed every single day!

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: So, can you say it again, Chief? Just once is fine!
Is this starry-eyed girl, who's leaning in and shaking your arm as she makes those outrageous demands, really the top idol worshipped and adored by countless fans?
You turn to look for Nightingale, only to find she has already made herself scarce, leaving you alone with a Phanuel who has been unusually clingy lately. Looks like you're on your own on this one.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You've been acting out of the ordinary lately. What exactly are you trying to do?
Phanuel puffs her cheeks and pouts, her index fingers twiddling in front of her chest as she fidgets with a sheepish little sway.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: It's nothing special. I just feel... a little more at ease when you're watching over me, Chief.

Catching that your expression has turned serious, she quickly flashes a smile again, as if the honesty made her uneasy. She curves her eyes into a cheerful squint and steers the conversation right back.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Of course, it's different from how my fans watch over me. I've seen it too many times. It's shiny, warm, and it feels good to be looked at like that. But it's also very easy to lose sight of who you actually are under that kind of gaze.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: When you look at Phanuel though, Chief, it's like you're peeling away the shiny wrapper, layer by layer.
Phanuel looks up at you, as if checking whether disappointment has crossed your face.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: You'll keep watching over me, right, Chief?
[Scene Change] Bureau Room, with Bed
Outside the window, Eastside's neon lights flicker through the night. The bustling streets don't go quiet just because an idol has fallen from grace.
On the billboard, Phanuel's massive poster has been taken down, replaced by an unfamiliar young face wearing a bright smile.
This city is always like this. Some rise to the stage amidst thunderous cheers, while others step down in silence. The applause is deafening, but it never lasts.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Does this make me look a little more sincere?
The phenomenal idol who once had countless eyes chasing her every move now sits before a small Bureau desk, earnestly practicing her smile in the mirror.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Lower lashes... a little further down... This should look more innocent, right? I wonder if Chief would like this style?

As she speaks, her eyes drift to the lower right corner of the mirror. There, a photo of Chief is taped in place, quietly stolen from the bulletin board in the hallway. Around it, a ring of Phanuel stickers has been stuck on, crooked and uneven, circling the person in the photo.
Ding. Her portable terminal buzzes. The schedule for next week has come through.

Phanuel sits up straight and scrolls through it one item at a time. Psychological counseling, special power management, physical training, independent living skills, low-stimulus observation... What is pre-sleep meditation...?
Still, she doesn't question any of the items she couldn't make sense of. She looks over the packed schedule with quiet satisfaction and sends back a cute little emoji.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Honestly, they could've scheduled more events with Chief. Phanuel can fight Corruptors too, you know... probably?

Phanuel switches off the small lamp and climbs into the modest bed. The blanket carries the scent of the sun. There is no lavish furniture, no luxury goods, no floor-to-ceiling glass windows, yet she feels more at ease here than in any mansion she's ever lived in.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: If I keep playing along, keep up the act... he'll peel back the layers, again and again, and show me the "me" that he sees... Maybe, just maybe... I can find myself again then...
steps.female_content: If I keep playing along, keep up the act... she'll peel back the layers, again and again, and show me the "me" that she sees... Maybe, just maybe... I can find myself again then...

steps.content: Outside, moonlight filters through a thin veil of cloud. The city's billboard screens keep cycling in the distance. New pop songs, trending topics, and names rise and fall across the internet... But none of it has anything to do with her anymore.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Good night, Chief. See you tomorrow!
Phanuel doesn't turn off the bedtime alarm right away. She lets the soft melody play for a little while.
<color=#FFC9F3> <i><size=40>In someone's eyes
<color=#FFC9F3> <i><size=40>She sees a different side of herself
<color=#FFC9F3> <i><size=40>So unlike anything before
<color=#FFC9F3> <i><size=40>Worth more than any treasure
